description.en: A browser-first virtual acoustic object for exploring, hearing, playing, and placing a Cuntz positive organ.

modavisBinding.notes: VAO 0.5.0 final co-release binding to MODAVIS Ontology Network 0.1.0.

properties.https://w3id.org/modavis/vao/ontology#co: 45 observed keys and five combinable stop controls
Browser pointer, keyboard, optional MIDI 1.0, WebXR hand-joint proximity, and tracked-controller selection
properties.https://w3id.org/modavis/vao/ontology#ti: event-triggered sampled playback using VAO sustain-loop regions and a 0.3-second note-off envelope

activities.notes: Revision 2 preserves the prior payload while adding sourced physical calibration, portable control bindings, and corrected synchronization metadata.

protocols.procedure: Inventory exact existing PositivXR payload bytes, bind them to logical assets and profiles, generate deterministic carriers, and validate the release with the pinned VAO 0.5.0 reference implementation.

Transcribe total height, maximum width, and maximum depth from the public MIMO record https://mimo-international.com/MIMO/doc/IFD/OAI_ULEI_M0000243 without treating the metadata transcription as a new measurement.

Recover the original Unity AR scene root scale of 0.223 m per source unit and cross-check it against the MIMO closed-case dimensions and the modeled manual width. Preserve the wider open-door scan bounds separately.

Use audio time directly as animation time from 0 to 30 seconds, then clamp the animation while the recording's measured trailing silence completes. Audible boundaries were measured with FFmpeg silencedetect at -42 dB and an 80 ms minimum duration.
